description: Manages system-wide access control, user roles, and entity-specific permissions within the application. It defines what actions users can perform and what data they can access.

endpoints.name: GetSystemPermissionConfiguration
endpoints.description: Get the entire system permission configuration including all roles and their capabilities. This provides a comprehensive overview of the application's security model.
example_uses: How do I get the full system permission setup?
Show me all roles and their capabilities.
I need the complete permission configuration for frontend initialization.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve the comprehensive, system-wide permission configuration, typically for initializing frontend applications or understanding the overall permission structure.

endpoints.name: CheckUserRoutePermission
endpoints.description: Check if the current user has permission to access a specific route or page. This is useful for dynamic UI rendering based on user access.

route.description: The route/URL path to check permissions for (e.g., '/partnerships/contacts/123')

example_uses: Can the current user access the '/admin/users' page?
Check if I have permission for '/reports/financials'.
Verify user access to a specific application route.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to dynamically check if the currently authenticated user has the necessary permissions to access a given application route or URL path.

endpoints.name: GetEntityPermissionDetails
endpoints.description: Get complete permission details for a specific entity, including all possible operations and role requirements. This helps in understanding granular access for data entities.
example_uses: What permissions are needed for the 'Contact' entity?
Show me all operations and role requirements for 'Partner' permissions.
Retrieve the detailed permission configuration for a specific data entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve detailed permission information for a specific business entity (e.g., 'Contact', 'Partner'), including what operations are allowed and which roles are required for those operations.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserRoles
endpoints.description: Get the current authenticated user's roles and permissions. This provides immediate insight into the logged-in user's capabilities.
example_uses: What roles does the current user have?
Retrieve the roles assigned to the logged-in user.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to quickly retrieve the roles and basic permission information for the currently authenticated user.

endpoints.name: GetUserRolesByUserId
endpoints.description: Get roles and basic information for a specific user by ID (admin access required). This is for administrative purposes to manage user roles.

userId.description: The ID of the user to retrieve role information for

example_uses: Retrieve the permissions for a specific user ID.
Show me the roles assigned to user 'john.doe@example.com'.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint (requires administrative access) to retrieve the roles and basic information for a specific user, identified by their user ID.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableSystemRoles
endpoints.description: Get all available system roles and their descriptions. This provides a list of all predefined roles that can be assigned to users.
example_uses: List all roles available in the system.
Show me the descriptions of all system roles.
What are the predefined roles I can assign?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a comprehensive list of all predefined system roles and their associated descriptions, useful for administrative interfaces or role management.
